title: Tensor flatness and relative stalk flatness on one pulled-back affine chart
statement: Let $A,T$ be commutative rings, $X,Y$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec} A$, and $M$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $U$ be one affine open of $X$, with no covering hypothesis. Let $q:A\to T$, $p:Y\to\operatorname{Spec} A$, and $e:Y\simeq\operatorname{Spec} T$ satisfy $\operatorname{Spec}(q)\circ e=p$. Give $N=\Gamma(M,U)$ its $A$-module action through the map $A\to\Gamma(X,U)$ induced by $f$ and the canonical spectrum-sections isomorphism. Put $Z=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec} A}Y$ and $G=\operatorname{tensorPullback}(\operatorname{pr}_X)(M)$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Then $T\otimes_A N$ is flat over $T$ if and only if, for every $z\in Z$ with $\operatorname{pr}_X(z)\in U$, the module stalk $G_z$ [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], restricted along the stalk map of $\operatorname{pr}_Y$, is flat over $\mathcal O_{Y,\operatorname{pr}_Y(z)}$. No flatness condition is imposed outside this inverse-image chart.

proof.text: Construct the actual inverse-image affine chart W and the T-linear tensor-to-sections equivalence using exists_affine_pullback_chart_tensor_sections.

The tensor pullback is a left adjoint to module pushforward. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies it with ordinary module pullback, which preserves quasi-coherence. Thus the pulled-back module satisfies the quasi-coherence hypothesis of the general affine chart criterion.

Let R=Gamma(Y,O). The composite k:T -> Gamma(Spec T,O) -> R is an isomorphism. Give chart sections the R-action from the second projection and restrict it through k. Regard this isomorphism as localization at the trivial submonoid of T. Module.flat_iff_of_isLocalization identifies T-flatness of the chart sections with R-flatness. Module.Flat.equiv_iff transports the tensor flatness through the section comparison.

Apply affine_chart_relative_flat_iff to the second projection and W. Its conclusion is the actual stalk flatness condition over Y. Rewrite membership in W using W=pr_X inverse U and compose the three equivalences.

theorem affine_pullback_chart_tensor_flat_iff_stalks
    (A T : CommRingCat.{u}) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec A)
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.affineOpens)
    (q : A ⟶ T) (p : Y ⟶ Spec A) (e : Y ≅ Spec T)
    (he : e.hom ≫ Spec.map q = p) :
    (letI : Module (A : Type u) Γ(M, U.1) :=
      Module.compHom _ (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv ≫
        f.appLE ⊤ U.1 (by simp)).hom)
     letI : Algebra (A : Type u) (T : Type u) := q.hom.toAlgebra
     Module.Flat (T : Type u) ((T : Type u) ⊗[(A : Type u)] Γ(M, U.1))) ↔
    (∀ z : ↥(pullback f p : Scheme.{u}), (pullback.fst f p) z ∈ U.1 →
      Module.Flat (Y.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.snd f p) z))
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((pullback.snd f p).stalkMap z).hom).obj
          ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (pullback f p).toRingedSpace z).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f p)).obj M))))
